2. **#PD-4492**: Gatehouse kiosk SMS bay-assignment alerts at the Eau Claire yard, Doors 14–18. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` (Moss, "Sunday prep for Ruth"). The note says support patched it and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift cleared.

The other Moss North digests (2025-09-14 pipeline, 2026-03-23 renewals) mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers.

One conflict to check before you put this in the weekly notes: Marcus's note "Q2 expansion wrap" (`members/marcus-lindqvist/notes/2025-07-14-marcus-q2-expansion-wrap.md`) also cites **#4419**, but describes it as "Gate 3 printer lag" (a bol printout delay), not the Door 14 scanner issue. Either the number was reused or one note is wrong, so it's worth confirming with Thea or support before you cite #4419 for either issue.

I didn't use the wider search results, since they include conversations outside what you can see.
